title: The D23 correctness comparison runs on at least 100 paired units with a McNemar verdict
body:
Why: on the valid protocol (evals/d23/harness.ts overlay, interface paragraph) K scores 2/16 vs P 3/16 paired (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/regrade-iface2); research (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/research.md) puts a detectable +15pp paired win at ~80-150 units, so 20 units cannot show K beating P.
Outcome: a unit selector in evals/d23/ picks at least 100 merged KRN pull requests whose tests fail on the parent and pass on the merge under the harness overlay, and the replay+regrade runs on them for both arms; the summary line adds an exact McNemar p-value on the discordant pairs.
Proof: node evals/d23/regrade.ts prints 'paired K x/n, P y/n, McNemar p=...' with n >= 80.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/, .krn/runs/d23-comparison/.

n100 protocol preregistered 2026-11-12: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/protocol.md sha256 496ad2bb1b18f7af (dev = old 20 units, test = first 100 valid of n100/candidates.txt; K tuned on dev only; McNemar p<0.05).

n100 verdict (2026-11-12, frozen K 6c91648, protocol .krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/protocol.md amendment 1; regrade .krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/regrade, --jobs 4 then 10, no harness timeouts in any failure tail).
- Primary (100 test units): `node evals/d23/regrade.ts` prints 'K functional 13/100, P functional 10/100, K scope-clean 72/100, P scope-clean 56/100; paired K 13/92, P 9/92; McNemar p=0.219'. Protocol-literal (no-patch arm = incorrect, all 100): K-only 5 (462,510,575,588,610), P-only 2 (467,609), p=0.453. Verdict: no difference shown.
- Secondary (28 units the judge labels D or P; 9 D, 19 P, 72 N): paired K 12/26, P 9/26, p=0.375; all 28: K-only 4, P-only 1, p=0.375. Verdict: no difference shown.
- K arm produced no patch on 7 units (436 is P's only), so K loses 7 paired units to its own crashes; scope-clean favours K 72 vs 56.
